The second line in `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-business-unit.object.ts:17` is the same sentence one package over; splitting a two-line prose fix into two cards is worse than the exception, so this is a **triage-designated cross-domain exception**: the claiming seat declares the full file surface (exactly the two files named in the card body, docstring lines only) and runs the targeted in-flight check against `domain:metadata` claims before dispatch.

Both docstrings should name `unit_and_subordinates` as the subtree consumer, per the card. Docs-only ⇒ `skip-changeset`.

Size/model suggestion: S-mechanical, `sonnet` — a natural member of the surface seat's next sweep batch rather than a solo dispatch, if one is pending.

- File surface (triage-designated cross-domain exception, both files declared): `packages/spec/src/contracts/sharing-service.ts` (the `IBusinessUnitGraphService` docstring) and `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-business-unit.object.ts` (the `Drives:` bullet). Docstring lines only.
- Container & model: `mode:subagent`, `sonnet` (S-mechanical under the 2026-08-12 dispatch-backend ruling)
- Serial constraints: none — hot-file sweep over all 9 open PRs found no other claim on either file (#8139 touches `security-service.test.ts`, #7996 touches `sys-session.object.ts`).

Premise re-verified on `origin/main` @ `a0151e98` before claiming, per E9:

- Both drifted lines are still present, at `sharing-service.ts:564-566` and `sys-business-unit.object.ts:16-19`.
- The narrowing did land: `9b519815` ("business_unit recipient expands exactly one unit, not the subtree (#7807)"), and `sharing-rule-service.ts:729` now resolves `business_unit` through `expandUnitMembers`, while the `unit_and_subordinates` branch below it keeps the subtree walk.
- `business-unit-graph.ts:47-52` already carries the corrected two-width wording, so the target phrasing exists in-repo and does not need inventing.

One open point handed to the developer rather than settled here: the two triage comments disagree on the changeset (docs-only ⇒ `skip-changeset` vs. patch). Neither is adopted — the developer measures it per this lane's render-input criterion. `contracts/**` JSDoc does not reach generated reference pages, but a docstring on an **exported** symbol can reach `dist/**/*.d.ts` hover, and `IBusinessUnitGraphService` is exported; the `sys_business_unit` object docstring needs the same check against its own package's build output. Whatever the measurement says is what ships, with the evidence in the PR body.
